paragraphs.text: Finroy was a man from Tyarel who lived during the Ice Age of Terisiare , on the plane of Dominaria .

Finroy's uncle was a successful jeweler, who took Finroy in when his parents died from a plague. When Finroy was eighteen, he traveled to Jornstad to study history. There, he eventually came under the employ of the popular regent, Lord Rothchild . Discovering that Rothchild was a drunken lecher, Finroy had to step in and pretend to be him by donning Rothchild's shining armor on at least two occasions. The first involved jousting against Sir Udo , which resulted in a lance blow to the chest that required Finroy to receive healing afterward. The second was on a hunt against the scaled wurm Rhindle , which resulted in Finroy receiving a broken thigh. Nevertheless, Rothchild was as popular among the townsfolk of Jornstad as ever.
